notes.title: V. 3.21 "Color Palette Update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: Go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads.

[b]Changed level 0 wallpaper colors[/b]

Probably the largest change and this update's namesake. The walls in level 0 are now bright green, the ceiling tiles are beige, and the carpet is tan. The colors are now much more accurate to the original picture. Previously, the colors were much more yellow and brown.

[b]Revamped level 4[/b]

Level 4 has recieved a facelift! The wall, floor, and ceiling textures have been changed, along with many other textures in the level. Trims have been added to almost all of the walls, and they have turned black. More props have filled rooms, and the lighting has become softer. The ambient light level has been increased. Broad windows and more single windows have been added, giving even more light. Small paper scatter has also been added to finish out the revamp. Suggested by Clouddealer on our discord.

[b]Added wooden frames to windows[/b]

Small wooden frames have been given to the sanity-draining windows. This does not change the overall size of the level.

[b]Added more scatter to levels[/b]

Some subtle scattered rocks and paper have been added to a couple of levels. More will be added in future updates, but for now this only affects levels 4 and 8.

[b]Added more props to level 974[/b]

Level 974 has recieved many more props and pieces of furniture to deck out nearly every room. Also, there are now actual light fictures on the ceiling where those were missing previously

notes.title: V. 3.20 "Musical update"
notes.content:
ATTENTION: Go to BrVR's steam library page -> gear icon -> properties -> betas -> and opt into this update by selecting the beta branch. Now, instead of everything being on the main branch, the weekly updates will be put on our beta branch more frequently than our main branch. This is to reduce unwanted update downloads.

[b]Added concertina[/b]

A nice instrument. Plays one of three sounds when the trigger button is pressed. It can be found in level 11's radio studio. Suggested on our discord server by Gatchi13

[b]Added player piano[/b]

A piano that plays music and can be found in level 3's MEG outpost.

[b]Updated the rave room[/b]

The rave room in level 1 was completely empty until now. Now there's a dancefloor, some drinks, some more lights, and other things.

[b]Added "super glowsticks"[/b]

These are special glowsticks that are way more useful than the original ones. They are brighter and the light attenuates more. They can be crafted using 1 plastic and 1 gasoline.

[b]Added extra blocking walls to level 35's offices[/b]

Previously, this was strange due to being able to see straight through into the void. This is fixed.

[b]Revamped zenith stairway[/b]

Now there are more props like shelves, plants, and other office-y props.

[b]Spruced up level 1's props[/b]

Added chairs, lights, rocks, and other things to the MEG base. Also, added back a spotlight to the middle of the first section that was removed some time ago. Also, added a couple of walls made of rocks to the hallways in the level to disrupt flow.

[b]Fixed ppsh ejections[/b]

The PPSH now ejects bottlenecked casings.

notes.title: V. 3.19 "Level 44 update"
notes.content:
[b]Added level 44[/b]

A sprawling retail complex level. Level 44 contains two different areas, the stores and the back areas. The stores have orange walls and bare shelves with store closing signs on the ceiling. The back areas have brick walls, machinery, and some resources scattered around. There are also some rare occurances, like finding rooms that have red lights or a room that has a strange electrical noise. The only entities are skin-stealers. Level 44 uses the infinite generation algorithm.

[b]Added door pictures to levels 44, 163, 250, 370, 422[/b]

These should fill in some of the doors with no pictures in the hub. I will do more soon.

[b]Added rarely-spawning rooms to level FUN[/b]

There are two new room types you can find in level FUN. The first is a set of hallways with fences barricading the ends, blood spatter everywhere, and a metal roof. The second is a room like all of the other party rooms, except it contains supplies housed in chests.

[b]Added new year event[/b]

The new year's ball drop is BACK! Once it becomes midnight, the ball will drop and Srooc Light will fall from the sky. There will also be big "2024" text this year.

[b]Varied bullet hole decals[/b]

There are now four different bullet hole decal variants for small-caliber weapons.

[b]Fixed 870 BCG clipping[/b]

The bolt carrier group of the 870 shotgun would clip into the back of the gun. This is now fixed.

[b]Added LODs to skin-stealers[/b]

Since skin-stealers don't really need to be high-detailed at all times, LODs have been added to improve performance.

[b]Added tick delay for enemies[/b]

All enemies now have a delay for any scripts they perform every tick. This also increases performance.

[b]Added a BCG to the g28 rifle[/b]

It didn't have one, so now it does. This means you can use the bolt release that was already implemented for the M4A1

[b]Fixed some visual issues with doors[/b]

Since doors got resized in the last update, there were several visual breaks with extra doors and text attached to no-clip-a-matics. These should be fixed.

[b]Fixed greenrooms door picture[/b]

Previously, it wouldn't render. Now it does!

Happy new year everybody! 2024 will be bright as ever, and we plan to continue improving the game and adding new features in 2024.

notes.title: V. 3.18 "The small QOL update"
notes.content:
[b]Added a weird sideways staircase level to level 370[/b]

A secret sublevel has been added to level 370! This level is merely a dark version of level 998's staircase, but turned 90 degrees on its side. Very trippy.

[b]Added a christmas tree and wreath to the frontrooms[/b]

It's the christmas season. In the last update we made partygoers wear hats, and now we bring more christmas decor. This will be the last week to access it!

[b]Removed level 4 brick spam[/b]

This was a strange feature where you could shoot a spot on level 4's wall to get bricks. This has been removed.

[b]Turned up level 7 voiceline's volume[/b]

Previously, it was very silent. This is fixed.

[b]Added haptics to many objects[/b]

Revolvers, lighters, torches, glowsticks, and other items now have haptics for interaction.

[b]Made doors slightly taller[/b]

Doors used to be around the player's standing height, now they are taller.

[b]Added a resubmit button to the questionaire[/b]

Once you submit the questionaire in the tutorial, there is now a resubmit button that you can press.

[b]Scrap gun now needs to have the ejector pulled open[/b]

The scrap gun seemed to be too simple to operate. Now, you have to pull open the ejector, increasing reload time.

[b]Improved sandbox item menu hit detection[/b]

Selecting items on the sandbox item menu is no longer as buggy.

[b]Lessened the cooldown between changing channels on the radio[/b]

Self-explanatory

notes.title: V. 3.17 "The Hidden Rooms Update"
notes.content:
[b]Added Red Room Radios[/b]

In this new update, there are now many red rooms you can find throughout the backrooms. These always are crammed with props or rubble, and have a single radio sitting on a table. When turned on, the radio will play any number of creepy sounds depending on what level you're on. These can be found in levels 2, 3, 15, 22, 25, 33, and more.

[b]Revamped level 9.1[/b]

This fixes the specularity of the rocks, adds a ton of rubble, and adjusts fog. Pretty basic changes but it really changes the feel of the sublevel.

[b]Added back alleys to level 15[/b]

The large open spaces in level 15 have been replaced with even more cramped corridors. Even though they're far away from the spawn where most of the lights are, these spaces are still lit.

[b]OOB no-clip[/b]

If a player reaches -300,000 centimeters below the floor of the level, the level will restart. So, if you fall out of the map this will help.

[b]Added sounds to level 40 minigames[/b]

The button to start them now plays a little beep, plus the turrets in General Starflare's Entity Mowdown now play a firing noise.

[b]Added shadows to level 18[/b]

This change adds a lot of depth to the level! Also, I changed the colors up a bit, now the sky is a bit more purple.

[b]Added partygoer santa hats[/b]

It's Christmastime in the backrooms, and the partygoers are showing up with all sorts of jolly greetings such as a tooth-filled arm to the face.

[b]Fixed some z-fighting in level 36 [/b]

A small change that fixes some texture flickering with the doors to the parking garage.

notes.title: V. 3.16 "The attachment overhaul update"
notes.content:
[b]Overhauled gun attachments[/b]

Now, one tap with the screwdriver will activate the attachment, then you can tap again to change it from a red dot to a laser to a scope. This makes attachments simpler and you don't have to worry about losing them through levels since you can just re-apply them!

[b]Added a new radio show to the portable radio[/b]

This one features Radio Ralph ranting about skin-stealers and his way to work, then capping it off with a nice musical number. The runtime is around 5 minutes. It is also available on youtube, the video is named "Radio Ralph Backrooms Radio Excerpt".

[b]Added a new area and exit to level 20[/b]

Now you can jump over the wall near the loading bay to gain access to a back area with a bunch of rooms.  The door there in the back gets you to level 21.

[b]Revamped level 23[/b]

Now the level has a ceiling made of ground with huge upside-down trees. There's also 2 new glow rooms, each are snaking complexes full of rooms and treasure. There's also a new exit that leads to level 46.

[b]Added a hand cannon[/b]

A simple craftable weapon capable of firing one very heavy round, and that's it. Once it's fired, it's fired. Carry 3-4 for best results. Suggested by Gatchi13 on our discord server.

[b]Changed some firing sounds[/b]

Shotgun firing now has a boomier sound, and the m1 garand's firing sound is also much punchier.

[b]Changed 1887 shotgun shell animation[/b]

The shells inside the gun will now correctly animate to display the state of how much ammo is inside of the gun.

[b]Fixed fatal error on level 94[/b]

You would spawn in the sky with no way to get down, this is fixed.

notes.title: V. 3.15 "The DIY Update"
notes.content:
[b]Redid crafting[/b]

There are now over 10 different crafting materials, all able to be stored in an ammo pouch-like system. These materials now show up on the crafting table UI and crafting is simply a button press. Much more fluid and much better than the old system. Also, it is more polished in many areas.

[b]Added crafting material drops in many levels[/b]

You will now see crafting materials in many levels such as 2, 3, 9, 20, and others. Those levels I've listed are hotspots, but many crafting materials are available in other levels too.

[b]Added brass knuckles + dagger[/b]

No, they aren't two separate items. You can now craft brass knuckles that have a dagger attached already, and it is much more powerful than the standard ones.

[b]Added brick on a stick[/b]

It's literally a brick affixed to a fire axe handle. It does a good bit of damage and has a large hitbox. It even allows you to do ledge clambering, similar to the game "Getting Over it". However, it is also very heavy and unwieldy.

[b]Added scrap gun[/b]

A single shot 7.62x51 rifle made out of assorted metal and screws. It is relatively simple though, once you put the bullet in the slide automatically goes forward and once you shoot it automatically thrusts back, ejecting the round.

[b]Added scrap gun auto[/b]

A 9mm version of the gun above. It also fires from an open bolt and is very unwieldy. It is very similar to the Mac-11 SMG.

[b]Added scrap flashlight[/b]

A flashlight with very bad efficiency and a scrappy appearance. The battery wears out twice as fast compared to the normal flashlight.

[b]Added scrap crowbar[/b]

It's a plain, grey crowbar but with a knife affixed to the curved end for extra damage. Also has a very large damage hitbox compared the the normal crowbar.

[b]Added punching[/b]

Ever found yourself in a really sticky situation and you didn't bring adequate weaponry? Maybe that longsword is just out of reach? Well, now you can just punch the entity! Note that punching does very little damage and is generally only a last-ditch "defense". Suggested by Gatchi13 on discord.

[b]Fixed a weird bug with head gore[/b]

While facelings played their scream animation, it turns out that if their head exploded they would bug out instead of dying properly. This is fixed.

[b]Added sideways recoil to Mac-11[/b]

This simple changes increases the SMG's spread without being too terribly obtrusive. It also reduces the long-range potential of the weapon.

[b]Rebalanced certain stashes[/b]

Some stashes have loot added/removed from them compared to when they were first added.

[b]Added physical bolt release to m4a1[/b]

A fun feature for realism. Now, once you're done firing the bolt will lock open just like on the real gun, and you can press the bolt release to send the bolt flying forward, picking up another round. Alternatively, you can just pull the charging handle.

[b]Changed magazines for m4a1, ak47, aks74u to all have 30 rounds[/b]

Self-explanatory

[b]Made the mk3 bolt more accurate to irl[/b]

The bolt handle moves now, but the piece behind it now remains at a net 0 rotation.

[b]Made the killshack mini range longer[/b]

I've made it longer, added walls on both sides, and staggered the targets so that you can do some longer-range shots!

[b]Removed assault rifles from levels[/b]

Many AK-47's and M4A1's have been removed from levels. As we've always said, we're constantly shaping the game to lean less on piles of guns and more on bought/crafted/scavenged guns. Pro tip: if you want an AK-47, then your best bet is to go to Shadow Tactics on level 1's BNTG base.

[b]Simplified ammo pouch[/b]

Small change, the ammo pouch now counts ammo in terms of small and large ammo compared to how it was originally (it counted every magazine separately). This is really big for me, so I can add things to the ammo pouch system without excess hassle. This also effects ammo making, so you can craft small and large ammo now. This does not effect shotguns or grenade launchers, and you will continue to be able to use all of the shells you love.

[b]Blued Russian ammo correctly[/b]

Russian ammunition (7.62x25, 7.62x39, 5.45x39) was not correctly colored. This is fixed, giving the rounds a greenish hue with more orange lead.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
This hotfix includes two things:

[b]Redo of vault changes[/b]

In the latest update, the vault was changed from infinitely spawning items to having a set quantity. We got a multitude of people from our steam community and our discord server saying that it was a bad change, so we have listened to all of you and reverted that change! I don't believe this should have any impact on your vault's save data, it should only affect the spawning/saving of items.

[b]Gun sound changes[/b]

The G28 and M4A1 rifles now both have a new charging handle grab/release noise. This noise is much more realistic as it was recorded from a very similar gun in real life!

notes.title: V. 3.14 "Frontrooms Sweet Frontrooms update"
notes.content:
[b]Added youtube to the frontrooms TV[/b]

You can now browse youtube while sitting on your couch eating fried chicken. Two caveats: It loads quite slowly, and there isn't really a search function. But, you can still totally watch some content!

[b]Made the frontrooms computer functional[/b]

The frontrooms computer now has the same script as The End's computer does. This means the computer can turn on/off, restart, launch applications, access the start menu, etc.

[b]Items in vault cannot spawn infinitely now[/b]

A big change! Now, if you put one item in, you get one item out. This helps balence a lot of the game, as if you have an M4A1 and lose it, it's gone for good now! (Unless of course you go back to exactly where you died).

[b]Added an adapter to the frontrooms computer that allows you to read notebook notes[/b]

The notebook is a small, cramped interface for reading the notes you have gathered, so now you can press a button on the frontrooms computer to go into a note viewer. You can see all of the notes you've gathered and put into your notebook!

[b]Added Level Theta[/b]

Our first user-created level made by Gatchi13. It's an aquarium level, with many glass enclosures and many corridors. There is also a long ramp that leads from the top of the level to the very bottom. Off of that twisting and turning ramp, there are many hallways which lead into rooms like galleries, shrines, pools, and more. There's also an office room at the top and a mysterious shipping container maze near the bottom. If you adventure far enough into this level (it's huge!) you can even find a long-lost locomotive. We applaud Gatchi13 for creating this level and we hope that other user-created levels will be added in the future!

[b]Added more rubble to level 22[/b]

Self-explanatory. Level 22 was supposed to be a destroyed car park, and it is indeed now a destroyed car park.

[b]Added stashes to The Mountain Village[/b]

The Mountain Village was such a linear level, and now I've spiced it up with a good few areas outside of the main valley. Those being a stash, and a random loot area.

[b]Added more detail to levels negative 6 and negative 8[/b]

In level negative 6 there is now more cinder-block rubble and props. In level negative 8 there are now more rocks coating the walls and less rigid architecture.

notes.title: V. 3.13 "The lost treasure update"
notes.content:
[b]Added stashes to levels[/b]

These bits of lost treasure are tucked away in unlikely places on many different levels of the backrooms! They contain a gun, an item case, and a note from whoever left the stash. These stashes can be found in a multitude of levels! They are often very hidden though.

[b]Added random loot cases full of money[/b]

These new loot crates look like yellow versions of the item crates, but they have 3000 backrooms bucks worth of cash inside of them. They randomly spawn in levels such as 2, 3, 5, and 13. Generally they spawn more in more mazelike levels.

[b]Added new money stack[/b]

This money stack feels good to hold because it's 10 100bb bills stuck together! These are found in the cases mentioned prior.

[b]You can store money with trigger now[/b]

Money can be pocketed into your wallet now by just pressing trigger in a similar way to adding ammo to your ammo pouch.

[b]Tutorialized money[/b]

Money now has a small section at the very end of the tutorial where it shows you what money looks like and how to store it.

[b]Replaced the death and damage noises[/b]

The "UUGGGGHH" noise has been replaced with lighter grunts for small damage and bigger ones for death. Suggested by Grimnee on our discord server.

[b]Added We've got Skin to Quarter Life[/b]

The fourth chapter of Fordon Greeman's adventures continues with We've got Skin. A pretty long chapter taking place in a storage facility. It is currently unfinished though, I will work on it soon.

[b]Added a bucket of chicken to backrooms burger[/b]

A bucket of KFC-style chicken, what else could you ask for? Deep fried and boiled with no artifical flavors. Suggested by Dave on our discord server.

[b]Revamped level 3[/b]

Level 3 got an absolute facelift. The layout remained the same, however all of the materials on the walls and floors changed. There is now cinder block rubble, trims, and other embellishments. It really looks decrepit now!

[b]Removed Bow + Arrow from tutorial[/b]

Simple change. It was fairly janky and we didn't want to highlight it in the tutorial.

notes.title: V. 3.12
notes.content:
[b]Redid backpack[/b]

A big change many people have suggested on our discord server. The backpack has been replaced with a better model and a new system for storing/receiving items. Instead of having six slots, you can now store an infinite number of things in there free-form. This is inspired by Into The Radius and Ghosts of Tabor. If you've played either, you know what I mean.

[b]Added level 36[/b]

A sprawling airport with two concourses and many exits. There are shops, gates, back areas, kitchens, lounges, restaurants, and tons of other explorable areas. You start in concourse A where everthing is eerily clean, and you can explore there and find loot. In concourse A, there are around 10 gates and no entities. Then, you can make the journey to concourse B which is crumbling and delapitated. There are entities in concourse B, and a similar amount of explorable area to concourse A.

[b]Items now persist in hands[/b]

If you're taking items from level to level, items will now persist that are in your hands. Pretty simple change.

[b]Educated about backpack in tutorial[/b]

Added some tutorial text showing how to enable the backpack and where it is placed on your back once enabled.

[b]Added an exit to the level creator[/b]

The "Level Creator" map in the Devrooms didn't have a conventional exit, so I added one. It leads to level 15 as of now.

[b]Added gun cases[/b]

These cases are now scattered around and replace actual weapons. They contain a gun and some ammunition. They are openable and now have a small space in the tutorial for them.

[b]Added item cases[/b]

These cases are scattered around levels of the backrooms and contain various items. Some cases include money, some include ammunition, some include other things.

[b]Redid ambient noises[/b]

The ambient noises that would randomly jumpscare you (while seeming to scare the daylights out of players) needed a rework. So, now they are much more subtle and build a sense of unease instead of a jumpscare.

[b]Added Beretta M9 pistol[/b]

A solid 15-round 9mm pistol. Now I wonder which is better out of the five pistols? This gun was suggested by Chaze on discord.

[b]Added cinder block rubble in some places[/b]

In level 2 especially, there are now patches of rubble made up of cinder blocks to add to the dismal mood.

[b]Added more exposed rebar[/b]

Also mostly in level 2, there is some more exposed rebar in various areas of the halls.

notes.title: V. 3.11
notes.content:
[b]Added setting: show slot hitboxes[/b]

Essentially the hitbox for the slots can be shown with this setting. It should make storing/removing items from the slots easier for sure. It also shows the ammo pouch. Suggested by Dave on discord

[b]Added setting: physicscam gravity[/b]

In the spectator category, this setting enables/disables gravity for the physicscam. So now instead of it floating away you can now lean it on something! Also suggested by Dave on discord

[b]Level 6 changes[/b]

Many new props in level 6 have been added (racks, chairs, tables, etc) and the no-clip wall in level 6 part 2 has been replaced with a glitchy backrooms no-clip wall.

[b]Disabled more unnecessary ticking[/b]

More and more props, signs and other items now have tick disabled which means less load on your machine.

[b]Turned down mac-11 recoil[/b]

I have turned down the recoil of the arm-bending, wrist-breaking submachine gun by 1/3.

[b]Something I forgot to mention[/b]

A bigger change I forgot to mention in previous devlogs: There's no "bootleg" variant of almond water anymore. We got rid of it because of its minimalistic packaging. Now, duller's den almond water takes its place.

We have two new levels we're working on: Level CRITICAL and Level 36! We will be putting those out there soon for all of you. Thanks for reading.

notes.title: V. 3.10
notes.content:
[b]Added level 35[/b]

A very hazy parking garage area with some outdoor parts. There are several new posters around the level as well. There is a sub-area with a more typical parking garage area, and another sub-area with some offices. Level 35 is infinitely generated.

[b]Added the Raging Bull 44 Magnum revolver[/b]

Suggested by Lor0roze on discord. It's a fairly power 6-shot revolver. It can be found in level 13 and in arena mode with all of the other guns.

[b]Made some changes to the vault[/b]

The vault in the frontrooms now spawns items a little off-center so you can see what's being spawned. In addition, more items now fit on one page of the interface.

[b]Small fixes[/b]

A couple of smaller things were fixed.

I will do some more community suggestions next update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: V. 3.9
notes.content:
[b]Made some changes to level 10[/b]

The car in the town is now a bit larger, and so is the wheat in the level. Also turned down some audio. Pretty basic changes. Suggested by KiloGram on discord.

[b]Added a "swap menu and jump button" setting[/b]

Pretty simple setting that swaps the location of the jump and menu buttons. Suggested by AtomicVoid on discord.

[b]Merged the radio station and the building in level 11[/b]

The radio station is now part of level 11, you can walk into it and walk out without no-clipping! A very nice change for the level, since Backrooms Burger is already like that.

[b]Added pumpkins to level 10[/b]

It's spooky month, so some pumpkins are in for level 10.

[b]Did more tick-based optimization[/b]

Many more objects now have tick disabled by default. This includes lights, small props, interactibles, and locomotion objects like ladders.

[b]Made several changes to level 9[/b]

The audio near the NRC building has been turned down as well as the ambient audio. Some streetlamps have been rearranged/added and some of the streets have been rearranged. In addition some white strips have been removed and the area near the level 10 exit has been redone. The lighting near the barn has been turned down slightly. Suggested by KiloGram on discord.

[b]Fixed infinite money glitch[/b]

Sounds like a joke, but it isn't! This infinite money generator allowed users to literally duplicate money in the vault. If you have used this glitch in the past, you should still be able to use it (we will patch that soon as well), but it should be patched for new users. Found by Gatchi13 on Discord.

notes.title: V. 3.8
notes.content:
[b]Added more areas to the siderooms[/b]

Essentially, there's now a parking garage type area tacked onto the front of the first sublevel giving the level a more grand start. Very atmospheric.

[b]Made changes to level 7[/b]

Level 7's spawn is less bright, the tape recorder plays louder, and the skeletons at the bottom are back. The exit to level 8 now has a large dark hole instead of a simple metal door.

[b]Did LODs for many meshes[/b]

This includes some guns, but it's mostly props in levels like foods, desks, tables, cabinets, and other larger furniture items that could use some optimization. (LOD stands for "Level of details" and it helps optimization to add them).

[b]Did optimizations to ticking[/b]

Some objects that shouldn't be called to function every frame now aren't called to function every frame. This includes several objects, like signs, houses, billboards, shells, and more.

[b]Made level 1 more optimized[/b]

It's still not there yet, however it is much closer. The two optimization techniques explained above go into effect here (and other places).

[b]Added many new openings in level 0[/b]

There are now several more openings and hallways to connect existing rooms. There are also more lights in darker areas to add to a monotonous vibe. There's also a couple of new "shifting wall" hallucinations.

[b]Removed a blocking vent in level 0[/b]

The annoying vent at the start of the level is gone. Yeah sure, you could just get the crowbar and destroy it. However, I don't fancy puzzles XD

[b]Replaced the Ice Cat memorial with the Basil memorial[/b]

Minor change, the "Ice Cat" cat memorial we put in game was for a cat who's owner is now a member banned from our discord server. We have replaced that memorial with one for our late cat, Basil.

That's all for today, thanks for reading!

notes.title: V. 3.7
notes.content:
[b]Added level 666[/b]

A very strange level. It's a long japanese shrine with a very dark atmosphere. There are several areas, including an out-of-place neon hallway and a control room. Some of the hallways even have human remains in them! Outside is a huge forest where you can fall into level -4. Suggested by SherlockBuzti and others.

[b]Added Purgatory[/b]

How do you get to level 666? Well, you have to go through purgatory! Purgatory is a very strange place inspired by weirdcore art. It has a huge branching path and a long section full of fake cloud wallpaper. Japanese text is superimposed on many walls, and one room has a ton of giant eyes!

[b]Added a new mission[/b]

Essentially, there is a new mission in MEG base alpha where you have to bring a special package (or several) to the MEG base on level 11. More of these sorts of challenges may be added soon. Suggested by TheGrimneeReaper

[b]Flashlight throw[/b]

Flashlights on average are a little brighter, and their cone of influence is greater. This makes traversing through dark levels like level 2 or level 666 much more bearable.

[b]Hub changes[/b]

The garden in the hub now has a piece of paper explaining the garden. In addition, the ends of the long tunnels have some doors leading to level -1 now.

Aaaaaaaand...that's it for now! Stay tuned for our future updates!

notes.title: V. 3.6
notes.content:
[b]Added toggle grab for Vive[/b]

Now, if you wish to use toggle grab on Vive (or on any other headset, it's just commonly used on vive), you can turn it on independantly from the Vive switch. Suggested by @flash the reploid on our discord. Thanks!

[b]Made several changes to level 4[/b]

This could warrant a few bullet points, but I'll put it all here. The black particles near dullers are larger, so you can now see them from farther away. The skin-giver on the other side of the metal door now can't hit you, the size of the records room is much smaller, and the levers in level 4.1 now have UI and sound associated with them. The level design is more open, allowing you to go straight from the stairwell down to the old level 4 area in just a few rooms. Removed some confusing lights here. There is a new hole in the drop ceiling where a partygoer can fall onto you. Also, lastly, there are more props near the stairwell room. All (mostly) suggested by @lunanightz on our discord. Thanks!

[b]Fixed brown hound ragdolls[/b]

Not only are the ragdolls grabbable, but a bug is fixed with the collider capsule for the hound AI itself becoming an impassible object. Did some other very small tweaks to this hound.

[b]Some weird events[/b]

In level 571, a TV can now be witnessed turning off and falling randomly. Also, there are a couple of other areas where something is a little...off. See if you can find them!

[b]Infinite ammo in the killhouse[/b]

It was a pain to have to gather ammo just to go have a fun time slaughtering fake entities. Now this pressure is absolved.

We'd love to say thanks to everyone on our discord playtesting and helping us find bugs! Also, a big thank you to the recent content creators picking up our game. Keep up the great videos!

Not the hugest update today, if you have any suggestions for the next one, let us know!

notes.title: V. 3.5
notes.content:
After last week's delayed release, we're back on time!

[b]Revamped level 22[/b]

The lighting is much moodier now, and there's more rubble. The whole place feels a little more explorational now. The layout has remained the same though.

[b]Added checkpoints to the tutorial[/b]

These stone pillars are now seen at the very end of the tutorial.

[b]Increased M4 shotgun firerate[/b]
[b]Decreased 1911 and m11 recoil[/b]

[b]Buffed entity health[/b]

The original hound now has much more health, other entities now have a little bit more health too. Some entities remained unchanged.

[b]Made hounds ragdoll better[/b]

The original hound, that is.

[b]Revamped level 26[/b]

Level 26 is much darker now, with a new section added on. The key is now located in the ominous boiler room, and the door is now located in the new area. The new area is an office sort of, with floral wallpaper and office-like furniture. Very maze-like.

[b]Added shifting walls and rooms to some levels[/b]

Level 33 now has an area where, if you go back after going forward, will enter a variation of the room you entered before. Same with a couple areas in level 0.

[b]Reduced suitcase fling[/b]

This change really just effects the mass and the "throw" of the suitcase. It's a little less flingy. You can still clobber entities with it.

[b]Added new signs to the hub[/b]

[b]Revamped level 71[/b]

Level 71 now has walls. Huge change I know.

notes.title: V. 3.4
notes.content:
After some issues with Unreal Engine we're back, but with a smaller update than normal. Just a couple of changes today.

[b]Memory worm has less health[/b]

It used to be indestructible, then it had an insane amount of health, and now it can be killed relatively easily, still takes 20-30 shots from the 1911. It's beefy.

[b]Added the fast smiler[/b]

Lurking in the back of level 2, the fast smiler is much faster than you can run, but has minimal health. Also, it has a more crazed smile than the other smiler.

[b]Smiler changes[/b]

Smilers are now generally faster, but with much less health overall. This has nothing to do with the addition of the fast smiler though, this is for the normal smiley bois.

[b]Added a "Rave Room"[/b]

In the emptu room on MEG Base Alpha's 2nd floor, there is now a color changing light with the song "Almond Milk Rave" by our discord member LunaNightZ. His name is also in the credits now. Thanks Luna!

[b]Revamped base beta[/b]

MEG's base beta is now more full of props, plants, and all kinds of other stuff. There's even an integrated workbench like in the other outposts! The office above is also fully furnished now.

That's it for today, between Bread or Dead (our other game), a trip to Maine, and Unreal Engine issues, I haven't been able to work on BrVR a ton. However, hope you enjoy this small fun update

notes.title: A slight delay
notes.content: We have been having some issues with Unreal Engine, and we will try to put out the update in the next few days.

notes.title: V. 3.3
notes.content:
Hey! We have had a suggestions channel in our discord server for a long time, and have been adding stuff from there throughout development. But, today we're adding some level suggestions that people have had recently. Probably the last level additions in a while, except for 217 which we have yet to put in and will probably be in the next update.

[b]Level 422[/b]

A long hallway level, with ornate carpet and wallpaper. The level loops many times, but has small rooms interspersed randomly along with window entities. There's a smiler near the end of the level, and a door that leads to level 23. This level was written (and suggested) by @ms.cyrixohhh on discord. Thanks!

[b]Level 163[/b]

The level starts on an elevator going straight up, and after a short ride you reach the top. The top itself is very purple and glowy, it has many high-rise buildings and trees for scenery. There are purple clouds in the distance and a thick fog covering everything. Jump off the buildings to enter level 11. Suggested by @niflheim on discord, as with the next two.

[b]Level 250[/b]

Level 250 is a field of sorts, although quite bumpy. It has a lot of plant life in the way of ferns and dense grass in parts. There are two stars overlooking the level, with pulsating interiors. There's a ray of light cast by one of the stars that leads to level 39.

[b]The mountain village[/b]

This creepy dark level is strangely peaceful. The entire level takes place in a valley, with a smaller bowl in the middle. The player spawn is at the outskirts of the bowl, and up a small hill is a house with almond water. In the middle of the bowl is another house with a neat thing inside (I'll let you guys find out what I'm talking about!) and a secret shotgun. Following the lamps, it leads to a road, and then off into a cabin to exit. There's also an expansive field outside the bowl.

[b]Level 0 map edits[/b]

The exits to level 2 and 3 have been turned into level 1 exits. A vent has also been unblocked allowing instant passageway into the maze-like part of the level without having to go around.

turned down the flashlight noise

Improved torch lighting

Made materials in level 17 better

notes.title: V. 3.1
notes.content:
[b]Added level 370[/b]

A pool themed level named "The skypools". A peaceful level with two houses on opposite ends. There are multiple steam baths throughout the level, with balmy steam rising from them. There aren't any entities, however a hound may be added soon.

[b]Added the 1887 shotgun[/b]

The first 6-round shotgun in the frontrooms, but the third in the backrooms! Lever action, meaning it needs to be racked every time to be fired. 

[b]Redid the partygoer tooth mesh[/b]

The "tooth" that was once 3 cones is now a full mouth, with visceral teeth and green skin. Fits perfectly on the lil partygoer arm.

[b]Added a nuke[/b]

Just a nuke. Nothing special. Accessed via the sandbox. Really it's just there to give you stress that the backrooms might blow up.

Once enabled, this option increases height by 50 centimeters. In addition, base height has been reduced by 15 centimeters due to reports of feeling tall.

[b]Suitcases are now nonexistent on level 4[/b]

[b]Partygoers are slightly slower[/b]
[b]Stray doors can now be opened from the handle[/b]

[b]Enlarged weapon boxes in the tutorial[/b]
[b]Removed the 0.2 demolition[/b]

notes.title: Version 3 of BrVR (ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE)
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Today we release fully, and are out of early access after 1 year and 1 month. Tons of new features, bug fixes, and upgrades today! This comes after 21 major updates in the 1.0 update cycle and 68 major updates in the 2.0 update cycle. All weekly, all the time.

Before we get started, we would love you on our [url=https://discord.gg/qm2mx2cdHh]discord[/url] to help shape the game.
Secondly, if you're enjoying the game please leave a Steam review with your thoughts.
Thirdly and lastly, Happy birthday to Banana Cat, one of our playtesters.

[b]Revamped the Tutorial[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42232632/6ad5f76890cdd1a728ef36be6d06716f998560df.png[/img]

The tutorial is all-new. It takes place in the frontrooms now, and has a brutalist concrete feel. It has two ranges, and a setup menu all integrated into the tutorial. The last room has been shortened, and the room with the upgrade bench and crafting bench now uses the integrated workbench layout. There is now a new section titled "Know your entity" which shows wanderers four entities and how to defeat them. This took Paul and I ages to put together, I hope you enjoy the new upgrades here!

[b]Added level 999[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42232632/5dba71f050ef2e3b443e4743142c331e64fa5a9c.png[/img]

A starry night sky is present with asteroids all around. It's peaceful, but it seems everybody left. There are also long-abandoned houses and taller buildings that house secrets. What were they doing there? This level also is completely greyscale. The comets fly by and you stare into the sky. How could this get more peaceful?

[b]Added Level 46[/b]

A long, windy, yet surprisingly calm desert level. This level is a giant "M" shape when you look at it from above, as you take three sharp turns to go from the start to the end. The start has a large temple and a small mountaintop ruins. It also has a large waterfall with a small rocky pond below. The ending section has an even larger sandstone temple, with extra houses where the exit door is located. There is a large oasis at the end as well, sporting tall palm trees and a large pool of water. There are also two small castle-like areas in the middle of the level that have supplies. In addition, there are many secret areas.

[b]New entity, sand demons[/b]

These beasts hide out in Level 46 and look like facelings, but with larger limbs and no face. However, the largest difference between them and facelings is that they are completely made out of sandstone. They jump to attack you, and the jumps do a bit of initial damage + bleeding damage. They can also melee attack, but this is much rarer to see.

[b]Avatars are now off by default[/b]

There is no checkbox to turn them on, you have to go to the frontrooms closet to turn them on now. You can also switch back to gloves only right there.

[b]Improved grab-pulling[/b]

Pulling an object from afar (while it still only takes up the grip button) is much more like Boneworks than the original BrVR. It interpolates the rotation (as well as the position) to the hand, is slower, and has a smaller radius to actually grab the item once it's pulled.

[b]Did accurate chambering mechanics to all weapons[/b]

Take the mag out, put it in, take it out again, put it in again, and as long as you have more than 0 ammo you won't have to pull the charging handle once. This works different for open-bolt weapons.

[b]Added 4 new songs[/b]

These are all tracks playing on the radios around the levels. These are all synth jams with a solid beat. They are all a bit different from the classical and jazz music heard in the other levels, a welcome break. This also means there are 4 new radios in these levels, but that begs the question who put them there? Hmmm.

[b]Added the supernova shotgun[/b]

A nice Benelli product now in-game! A solid 6-round pump shotgun that has a picatinny rail on top.

[b]Added more animations to entities[/b]

When you approach a faceling, he will play a new alarm animation and sound! In other words, he will scream at you! Hounds, when jumping, now have a new alarm sound too, and the chance for them to jump has increased from 20% to 33%.

[b]Added destructibles[/b]

Destructible vases, boxes, and more! Finally, players can open up the mystery "Amazon package" in level 0. Peace at last.

[b]Added stealth[/b]

Near an entity? See him in the next room over? Might just want to keep it on the down-low if you don't have any business fighting. Sprinting will now instantly alarm entities if you are near them. This isn't the same for all entities, some hear better than others. But generally speaking, sprinting 20 meters away from them is safe.

[b]Better partygoer balloon hit detection[/b]

Ever since version 1.3 and the dawn of partygoers in BrVR, you have been able to shoot their balloons. However, due to how projectile systems are built out, they all hit the balloons slightly differently. This is fixed, and you should be able to hit the balloons with anything now!

[b]Full auto balloon gun[/b]

A fun weapon for arena mode. Hold down the trigger and spray death, level fun style. Possibly outlawed in The Backrooms Geneva Convention after the FUN war in level 52, but the MEG still allows use of it.

[b]Added carrots, potatoes, and radishes[/b]

Three new fruits and vegetables! These aren't much different from the other ones in terms of nutrition though.

[b]Added new houses to level 9[/b]

Some near the second highway, and some elsewhere. There's also some new foliage and terrain variation on that level.

[b]Revamped the Charleston button in the snackrooms[/b]

Level 6.1, AKA the snackrooms, has never been this fun! Now pick from songs on a little UI, a simplified interface. This level has also been optimized considerably.

[b]Replaced sandwiches[/b]

What's better than sitting down in level 0 and having a good 'ol chicken sandwich? If you said "absolutely nothing", you'd be correct. Don't be a fool and go crazy back there, have a chicken sandwich on your person for tougher times ahead.

[b]Added the Degle .50[/b]

We are on the growing list of games that have this joke weapon. Cardboard deagle. What could be better? It does 20 damage compared to the 70 that the deagle does.

[b]Did PBR texture changes to levels 13, 15, 17, 11, 26, 40 and 3999[/b]

Level 13's wallpaper and carpet looks better. Level 15's walls look better. Level 17 actually looks like an aircraft carrier interior. Level 11 has normals and roughness in the streets. Level 26's walls look better. Level 40's carpet and walls look better. Level 3999's tiles look better.

[b]Renamed the M16 to the M4A1[/b]

Haha, it was named the M16 the entire time. We just completely missed this. Shame on us XD

[b]Fixed the Chris Vector hitbox in the casino[/b]

Try to steal Casino Chris' prized possession? Now it's a smoother experience. but remember, crime never pays especially with skin-stealers.

[b]Made Casino Chris play his own slot machine[/b]

Ever 13 seconds he reaches for a chip. Every 13 seconds he plays it. And every 13 seconds, he feels the crushing defeat come over his skin-stealer body. He lost again. Is this how it will end for Chris?

[b]Added a "skin-stealer room service" minigame[/b]

A silly little minigame, you deliver almond water to random rooms in level 13. You win 900 dollars per almond water served.

[b]Redid the bar 13 bartending minigame[/b]

Instead of an awkward, cartoony speech bubble, there's now a monitor that shows the order. Pretty simple change.

[b]Added more entity sports cards[/b]

You can buy them at the Pawn Shop in level 1 and hoard them with the "save level data" feature. In the next update, the prices will go up considerably and you will be able to sell them for money. Get in on the deals now! There are 8 different cards to collect, with more on the way. There are also "wax packs" that have 10 random cards.

[b]Added quarter life levels to the hub[/b]

Anomalous skin, Unforeseen skin, and skin complex are all available from the hub. You have to unlocked them first though, and since they're an Easter egg they aren't available in the sandbox hub.

[b]Added BUZTELLA[/b]

If you are a very certain person you may know what this means. Inside joke.

[b]Added new videos to the TV in the frontrooms[/b]

Some fun lil news broadcasts! These replace the old BrVR videos that were once on the TV

[b]Added more orange and blue crates to outposts[/b]

These give higher-value loot than the standard beige crate. They also require a crate key, and those can be found in outposts. You see where I'm going here.

[b]Added a new poster to the casino[/b]

It's for "social distancing" and it's a play on Casino Chris's animation. What a skin-stealer. Talked about him 3 times already. Stay "about this long" away from each other to stay safe from the hound virus!

[b]The batteries stick in the ammo pouch[/b]

No more scrambling for batteries when it starts to go under 25%. They are all in your ammo pouch like everything else.

[b]Added lamps that turn on/off via a button[/b]

These are just table lamps with simple buttons, nothing too special.

[b]Added machines that turn on/off with buttons[/b]

In level 15, you can turn on/off the machines with two separate interactions. These machines play pipe noises and such.

[b]Improved revolver animation[/b]

New sounds for putting in a speedloader, plus an empty speedloader now physically falls out upon it being done loading.

[b]Added a light function to the flashlight[/b]

It sort of shows "rings" around the flashlights cone of influence. This cone is slimmer, but is much longer than before. However, it is a bit duller overall (wall hack guy reference!)

[b]Added a working record player to the frontrooms and level 5[/b]

You can play disks, and the player has a moveable head. You can move it by pressing trigger while holding it. There is also a record player on level 5 with a different song. Real roaring 20's vibes.

[b]Added new molotov cocktails[/b]

It's a glass bottle now, has a fire effect, and a glass break noise. The functionality is the same.

[b]Revamped the hub[/b]

It looks a lot more like the wikidot picture! It's brighter, with more lights and lines. There are also curbs and more street markings. So much better than the old version.

[b]Optimization of many levels[/b]

Hardcore culling, lods, and texture changes has led to better framerates for all! Less stutter, less dropped frames, and more than that, more happy people (and skin-stealers) exploring the backrooms.

[b]Redid post-processing in the frontrooms apartment[/b]

The apartment looks better with better exposure settings and of course better color grading.

[b]Added more furniture to level 5[/b]

More chairs, pillars, nightstands, drawers, and more. Really livens up the place in the darker areas of the lobby!

[b]You can now upgrade the flashlight[/b]

It takes 2 batteries and a flashlight to upgrade. Once upgraded, the flashlight consumes 90 times less battery. How this is accomplished, the MEG will never know.

[b]Added an indication that slots are full[/b]

OMG! CAN'T STORE STUFF IN MY BACKPACK. GAME BROKEN.
Not anymore! Now you know when it's your fault that the slots "aren't working". You can also know when it's the game's fault (Awww c'mon!)

[b]Fixed recoil on the 870[/b]

Boomstick means boom, that boom includes some velocity backwards. So now instead of awkwardly turning, it actually pushes back. Crazy. (I was crazy once! They locked me in a room. A skin-stealer room with skin. Skin-stealer skin makes me crazy).

[b]Added removable caps to almond water[/b]

A bittersweet change, but a neat realism change. Essentially, you can pull the caps off and take 10 separate drinks now.

[b]Redid camp amber[/b]

More concrete, props, and a more grungy feel. This will continue to get more upgrades.

[b]Added a ragdoll fling multiplier[/b]

Ragdolls can fling upward with this new optional setting. This is legitimately hilarious. It only works for humanoid entities and hounds right now.

[b]Added a setting for watch presence on hands[/b]

You can have the watch be on both hands (default), right hand, or left hand. Pretty basic setting.

[b]Added a setting for door picture presence[/b]

If off, door pictures will show up and so will the back section of the no-clip-o-matic doors. If on, door frames and the clock will be the only things showing. Combine this with the doorframe replacements for a neat no-clipping experience.

[b]Revamped the cimkin rooms[/b]

Thanks cameraman. More fried chicken.

[b]Added physical props to level 71[/b]

Boxes are physical and able to be picked up. Pretty basic change.

...

That's it!!

...

A bit of a premature statement. There are tons of smaller changes I didn't mention here. However, that's all of the major changes. It's been a wild ride for us and our fam, and a really fun one.

For reference, BRVR WILL STILL UPDATE AFTER THIS UPDATE. We will continually fix things and add new content until BrVR hits "4.0". Then we'll do smaller, less frequent (mostly quality of life) changes. We started in October of 2021, and released Early access in July of 2022. But now, we have this big date and event to remember. We would like to thank our wonderful playtesters over on our discord for finding bugs and helping out immensely.

Hope you all have a fun time with this update!

notes.title: WE'RE RELEASING August 15th!
notes.content:
Thanks to all of our good feedback and positive interactions with our wonderful community, we've grown from a showcase of janky mechanics to an actual pretty polished game. Through tireless hours of fixing bugs, and even more adding suggested and original content, we've come a long way.

So, since we think the game is up to certain standards, we're releasing full release on August 15th. This means, to take the time we need to polish every last thing for full release, we will be pausing the weekly updates until August 15th. This means a likely massive changelog for the full release.

Thank you BrVR Family for doing what you do and being awesome!

notes.title: V. 2.68 (One year anniversary on Steam!)
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! Yesterday was our 1 year anniversary on Steam. Thank you all for an amazing year, and amazing feedback on the game.

[b]Added the integrated workbench[/b]

Essentially, the integrated workbench has a crafting table, upgrading bench, brewer, ammo maker, vault, and a furnace all in one! You kind find these setups at level 1's base alpha, at level 2's base, and in a couple of other isolated locations.

[b]Improved upgrading and crafting[/b]

Upgrading now has a UI to go along with it. It shows you recipes, and has a button to upgrade instead of automatically doing it. There are also 5 new upgrades for guns you can get! Remember to save them in your vault! The upgrades are as follows: A mac-11 with a muzzle brake for better recoil management, a 1911 with full-auto, an 870 with a 9 round tube, an m4 shotgun with a full choke, and a normal 870 (upgraded from the short 870).

[b]Added level 0.01[/b]

As part of the infinitely generated level 0, level 0.01 stands as a "chunkier" area with fatter walls and longer hallways. Everything else is the same though.

[b]Added a new mesh for the vault[/b]

Instead of being a blue hot tub-esque device, it is now a square tub with a vault door on top and a level 0 wallpaper signifying that items no-clip out of the vault when they are spawned.

[b]Improved the terror hotel casino[/b]

Added more than one big green button, moved some floating text, removed a stray mirror, and added some subtitles for certain things.

[b]A lot of small bug fixes[/b]

Some with the terror hotel casino, others with shelves, and others with the level 4 ladder area.

A bonus change: due to some technical glitches we were forced to rebuild the level 28, level 1020, level 201, and level 7 landscape materials from scratch. They mostly look the same as before, but the colors may be off in some areas. In addition, some pitch-black areas may form, but those will be taken care of shortly. I haven't found any myself, but they may be out there.

Thanks to all of our OGs who have stuck it out with us since before launch, and have since been with us through this amazing year. If you would like to shape the game please join our discord, and if you're enjoying the game (or not) leave a steam review with your thoughts. Thanks for reading, goodbye.

notes.title: V. 2.67
notes.content:
A smaller update today, but some neat changes!

[b]-Revamped the plastic tycoon minigame[/b]

Now has an upgrade system, a much better factory area, a new class to buy (the manager), and games save between levels. Happy plastic making!

[b]-Fixed a ton of small bugs[/b]

A lighting bug, a random door, a collision bug, a crafting bug, and tons of other stuff!

[b]-Added more rubble to level 3[/b]

notes.title: V. 2.57
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! As we approach our full release in July, the updates may become a bit smaller. We'll be tidying up for the big day as we also work on our other game. However, we still plan to put out weekly updates. So, here's some new features:

[b]Added semi-auto/full-auto switchers to many weapons[/b]

A long-awaited feature, you can now switch between semi-auto/full-auto on the AK weapons, m16, As-Val, and Mac-11. Single fire is the way to go for long-range shots.

[b]Revamped the entire level -0[/b]

This level is an odd one out in the Backrooms Wikidot, so we made it equally as weird in BrVR. Glitchy walls, odd colors, and a disorienting environment all contribute to the level. There are also some entities, but they're locked away in rooms where they can't get to you.

[b]Added several rooms to the end of level Run Dash Run[/b]

This should (hopefully) freshen up the level for speedrunners. There are a few new rooms at the end of this level that fade into a more "hotel" vibe. It's very cozy, but there's also a liquid slime to kill.

[b]Added more pipes and props to arena2[/b]

It now looks more like its reference level, pipe dreams. There are many more pipes now, and some other smaller additions like vents on the walls.

[b]Added a bunker to the middle of arenalevel10[/b]

This also gets rid of the walls that I added earlier. This bunker is filled with boxes, bricks, and crates. It's a great path to try to avoid the entities.

[b]Redid the front desk of level 188[/b]

A major overhaul! 188's front desk was previously just a desk and a monitor, now it's a grand lobby with rugs, chairs, tables, and better lighting. Some other rooms have been added to the level as well.

[b]Put the old frontrooms in the gallery[/b]

Ah yes, old BrVR stuff. You can now relive the days of the green walls and the server room.

[b]Hounds can now spawn with purple hair[/b]

"emo" hounds we call them, the edgiest of the entities. They are a 1/30 chance to spawn over normal king hounds. They aren't any different other than their hair color.

Alright, bye BrVRers!

notes.title: V. 2.56
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! Today's new features are:

[b]Added a new entity, Healing Windows[/b]

These blue windows increase your sanity instead of decreasing it. They can still be shot like normal white windows.

[b]Added more lights to level 4[/b]

Some dark sections have been improved, and some new furniture has been added to level 4.

[b]Height adjuster fix[/b]

A HUGE improvement to the height adjuster has been made. It is much less janky now. The auto calibration button also works, although the height adjusting system hasn't been tested on Index and Vive.

[b]Level7beta is out of the gallery, and is in the hub[/b]

The new level 7 is here! Experience a new entity, Tiny, and lots of bubbles! There are three stages to the level, each getting darker. Don't worry, the soothing level 7 music is still there alongside the cassette recorder and tape.

[b]Added an airhorn reaction to the thing on level 7[/b]

His light will go out when you airhorn him, nothing special.

[b]Changed the way that rounds divisible by five work in the level 62 minigame[/b]

On every round divisible by five, two things will happen. Either A: you get to shoot at frowners and smilers, or B: tons of does start spawning, and they are very fast. In the old version, there weren't as many does, this has been increased.

[b]Upgraded level 16's and level 11.1's water[/b]

Realistic water is always nice. In addition, the trees on level 11.1 have gotten a texture upgrade!

[b]The m16 and ak47 now have light sideways recoil[/b]

These guns were a bit too accurate. The first shot is still just as accurate though, so scopes are still useful.

[b]Squashed more frontrooms mesh polygons[/b]

We also squashed lag in the process. Even on VERY low-end systems, the frontrooms should run acceptably. (at 60-72 fps)

This change should really have an impact on how players use the double barrel. Strangely, this was very difficult to implement.

[b]Remade ramp collision on level 27[/b]

Tired of trying to clamber up stairs when the collision is janky and broken? Well, now the stairs on level 27 have been fixed. This should make speedrunning this level much easier. A timer has also been added at the end of the level.

That's all for today. However, we have rebranded our discord server and would love to have as many people as possible join the Woo Studios discord server: https://discord.gg/qm2mx2cdHh

Bye!

notes.title: V. 2.55
notes.content:

notes.title: V. 2.54
notes.content:

[b]Redid walking, running, and climbing physics[/b]

There's more acceleration when walking, turns are more sharp, and climbing is stabilized. Also, there is less bounciness on the body.

[b]Added another mile to Level RUN[/b]

This one features light rings, "knockdownable" doors, a cave section, and a surprise ending. There are also some fixes for level RUN's obstacles. Previously, you could sidestep a few that you can't now.

[b]Completely reworked the wrist communicators[/b]

The player now has two wristwatches instead of the MEG wrist communicators. The amount of features is pared back considerably, allowing you to only see your wallet, MEG exits, current time, and current level.

[b]Added some foliage to level 94[/b]

Ah yes, the tranquil animated kingdom. There's now some grass, and trees, and trees, and grass, and you get the picture.

[b]Added the m16 rifle[/b]

A classic military rifle now put to use in the backrooms. Its high fire rate and damage make it effective, but it does have a good deal of recoil.

[b]Added the Vector SMG[/b]

You might think that this is a Kriss Vector, but no! It's a "Casino Chris" vector, based on a popular skin-stealer. You can find this low-recoil smg in the level 5 casino, alongside Chris.

[b]Added some new areas to level 188[/b]

A few new rooms, mostly hotel rooms but also some hallways. The lighting has been improved here as well, and there are fewer entities. Another new addition is an outlook to the "outdoors" of level 188.

[b]Added the M1A rifle[/b]

This 30-round marauder is very similar to the M1 Garand, but grey. It makes its home in arena mode only as of now.

[b]Fixed some incorrect footstep noises[/b]

Stepping on some carpets would play the concrete footstep sound, and stepping on some wood floors would play the carpet footstep sound. This is now fixed.

[b]Fixed culling issues with oak trees[/b]

Sometimes, they would just [i]disappear[/i] at long distances, this is no longer the case.

[b]Did more animations for the revolver[/b]

An animation for the speedloader going into the revolver and an animation of the wheel spinning when the hammer is cocked back have been added.

[b]Changed some level 94 materials[/b]

Added some macro variation and better normals on the ground.

After taking a break for a week, we're back on it! Some hardware issues have kept us down, but we've prevailed. Here's some new features:

[b]Vive Mode[/b]

Something we've been working hard on. You can now enable "Vive Switch" in the gameplay settings, which changes a few things. First off, you press grip to grab and double tap grip to drop. Single tap grip to interact. There is also an additional jump button mapped to "up" on the right trackpad. Crouching is removed in Vive mode. These suggestions for Vive compatibility were made by a user named [i]Bonk![/i] on our discord server

[b]Weapon handling changes[/b]

Some guns are more heavy now like the revolver, 1911, 870, and the Deagle. The M1A1 SMG now has much less angular damping.

[b]APRIL FOOLS![/b]

There is now a table in the level 0 arena mode that has four very cursed weapons. A shotgun pistol, a "g36", a BAR with a long magazine, and a very obtuse deagle. In addition, there is a silly foregrip attachment that allows you to fly.

[b]Crowbar Changes[/b]

To make the infamous zipline in Level RUN easier, there is now only one grab point on the crowbar.

Kind of a small update for sure, but this next one will be much larger. Oh, and there's a new level 21 coming up to completely expand the current one.

A final note, keep an eye out for texture issues. Due to having to reinstall Unreal and Visual Studio on our machine, some textures may not render.

Bye!

notes.title: V. 2.52
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! Today we have a ton of changes and content additions!

[b]Added level Negative 10, a wasteland field[/b]

Level Negative 10 is a flat, grassy, nighttime level. But don't let its simplicity fool you, in the fog is a giant building full of wrecked furniture, blood stains, and bullet holes. What could have happened there? Outside of the building are a series of playgrounds, it's quite eerie.

[b]Added a new entity, bursters[/b]

These crouched crab-like figures hide in levels 3 and 6. When you get near them, they will "burst" on you, and then will be able to take damage from shooting. They also can bite you if you get very close. They are quite slow though, and can be outran simply by walking away.

[b]Added some variance to gun materials[/b]

Some, like the Deagle and 870, are a bit more grunge now. The M4 Shotgun's material is more metallic as well.

[b]-Added the M1 Garand to guns n optics n ammo[/b]

Isn't "Garand" such a good word? Either way, you can now buy it at your favorite frontrooms gun store. It's pretty pricy though.

[b]Added an "info" tab to the notebook[/b]

This tab can tell you all about the companies of the backrooms. It's currently a WIP and doesn't have everybody. Suggested by our playtester Purple guy.

[b]Added some props to buztitraining[/b]

Tables, chairs, and a skull (bad to the bone). Also, speaking of skulls, they have better LODs.

[b]Added Lucky Milk, a replacement for Condensed Almond Water[/b]

A nice addition straight out of the backrooms wikidot. It's soy milk with three different flavors, Banana, Strawberry, and Chocolate. It can be found in Holden's Anxiety Relief on level 94's indoor playground. It costs 80 Backrooms Bucks.

[b]Redid Level 23's lighting[/b]

This one just looks gorgeous. The glow room is also upgraded with many more plants, mushrooms, and other significant flora. There are now tons of multicolor lights inside there too. 

[b]Did an overhaul of the level 18 "Memories" map[/b]

This map has gone relatively unchanged for 3 days shy of a year now, since 1.7. It now has a graphical overhaul, with ambient occlusion, bloom, and flickering lights on high settings.

[b]Fixed no avatar mode's strange arms[/b]

This is a big one, not sure why it was happening exactly but now it's gone! Goodbye, black wrists, you won't be missed.

[b]Fixed a carpet issue in level 0[/b]

There was previously a line, where there isn't now. The only reason I put it on here is because it's one of the first things you'd see in level 0.

[b]Fixed an issue with a faceling noise[/b]

Sometimes it would play multiple times in a row, after using a grenade. Now this isn't the case.

[b]Compressed many textures[/b]

Things should run a bit better, at the loss of slight visual fidelity.

[b]The double barrel shotgun now costs $1200[/b]

It's now less expensive, due to mag size and the difficulty reloading.

[b]Changed the revolver rod and 1911 slide[/b]

As always, the 1911 slide is an ongoing effort. However, the revolver should be much easier to reload now, not requiring you to touch the end of your index finger to the ejector rod. It instead checks the entire hand's collision.

That's it for this update, however there are some other minor changes. Also, [b]we are going on vacation for a week[/b]. We have been working on the game nearly every day for the last year, and we've found we're burnt out a bit. We'll still be on our discord though, we love that. We are going to New Hampshire. Have a nice time brvring (or whatever you call this)!

Hello BrVR Family! Today we have a new rifle, some grenade-related adjustments, and more!

[b]Added a New weapon: M1 Garand[/b]

This new rifle, the M1 Garand, has a special grenade launcher to go along with it. You can attach it to the muzzle, attach a grenade and pull the pin. However, remember to pull the bolt afterward.

[b]Added firesalt crystals, a new mineable crafting material[/b]

You can drill into the walls of level 5's boiler room as they contain these new firesalt crystals, used to make explosives. They also glow a bit, providing a much-needed light source down there.

[b]Added two new grenades, mk2 and flashbang[/b]

The Mk2 is a frag grenade with a large radius and a loud noise. The flashbang allows you to stun entities, but can also blind you for a couple of seconds.

[b]Added a "Boom Box"[/b]

In arena mode, there was no way to get grenades. Now there is, with the boom box. Once the game is started, press the button to get grenades. This isn't spammable though.

[b]Added some new crafting recipes[/b]

Ever wanted to craft up some high explosives? Well now you can, with the crafting table! You can craft firesalt grenades, flashbangs, and the Mk2 frag grenades now.

[b]Added crafting and mining equipment to the level 5 boiler room[/b]

You can craft back there to your heart's content. Mine with new firesalt and steel deposits, plus a drill to mine with.

[b]The headphones now play a custom song[/b]

Just replace the mp4 in your game's local files with an mp4 of your song. It will play inside of the headphones in the frontrooms.

[b]Adjusted the arena mode graphics[/b]

Color correction, need I say more?

[b]Boards now despawn faster (from 20 to 2.5 seconds)[/b]

This should make navigating some levels like RUN much easier, as the pesky boards won't be getting in your way the entire time.

[b]Did some significant optimization to level RUN, including fixing several moveable light issues and installing more traps[/b]

Lag while speedrunning is NO FUN, so I've gone ahead and made several notable changes. There are more traps to reduce the count of unneeded entities, and the lamps are less taxing on your GPU

[b]Did some other optimizations[/b]

Pretty minor stuff, mainly to level 5 and its many areas. Also reduced the cost of lamps here.

[b]Fixed a visual issue with the crafting table[/b]

the texture would display incorrectly on the output pad, this is fixed now.

[b]Fixed a crash with level 9 old 2[/b]

This level should be free to travel to, [strike]without any travel restrictions by the MEG government[/strike]

[b]Fixed lots of bugs[/b]

Skin cube subtitles are gone, fixed a strange building in level 1020 and more. Also, jittering and stalling of the hands and body should be mostly fixed.

Added physical swimming, like in other water levels, and the scuba thrusters work again!

notes.title: V. 2.50
notes.content:
Hello BrVRers! Today is the 50th major update of BrVR since launch, hooray.

[b]Added Level 7 as a beta preview[/b]

Level 7 has been a favorite level of many since we first added it, however, it's time for a change! If you want to experience the new level 7, head to the gallery. It's way in the back, past level 5 classic. This new version features a not-so-friendly fish named tiny. There are several layers to the level, and even a couple of secrets. It's still a work in progress, so we put it in the gallery. [b]The tiny jumpscare is still on, even if you have entities off. This will be patched soon[/b]

[b]Replaced the Frontrooms Apartment with a much more modern one[/b]

We love our old frontrooms apartment, it's quite nice, and it's served us well. However, like level 7, it's time for a change. So, we changed it to a modern apartment. We still have the same TV, gallery, glove skins, and vault area. However, some things have been massively improved, like the vault being in a basement, the avatars being in the closet, and there being a grabbable camera.

[b]New spider entity[/b]

So, you think we already have spiders, having the level 8 jumpers, mama spider, yellow spiders, papa spider, and crawlers? Well, we have a new addition to the spider family of [strike]products[/strike] arachnids. These ones jump high, and attack big. Imagine the level 8 jumpers except they don't attach to you, jump higher, deal more damage, and move faster. Not to mention, they have more health and look exactly like the yellow spiders from afar. Only in level 2! 

[b]Added a grab point to the mk3 rifle[/b]

Ever wanted to hold it by the magazine? Well, now you can!

[b]Added a grab point to the mac-11[/b]

Ever wanted to hold it by the magazine? Well, now you can! [i]coughs[/i]

[b]Added a new item, headphones[/b]

Found in the new frontrooms apartment, the headphones play a sped-up version of the BrVR trailer music. It kind of sounds like d&b music, very unusual.

[b]Added walls to the arena level 10 map[/b]

Just short walls, nothing big. The map itself is still very open and easy to navigate, and more fun than the original.

[b]Added a halo effect to level 24 and changed the cliff color[/b]

The sun casts rays down onto the level, and it looks quite nice. The individual rays are separate as well. This effect has been applied to levels 11 and 1020 as well.

[b]Added a few new sections to level RUN[/b]

The speedrun wars on our discord server are back on! Many new sections have been added like a sideways area and a rock-falling section. In one section, there are bumps in the ground, adding verticality.

[b]Added a version of the gatekeeper shotgun with a foregrip[/b]

This feels great to handle for sure. Truly a gangsta gun, and probably the final version of the gatekeeper we'll be adding.

[b]Improved optimization on levels 201, The END, and 20[/b]

We have hopefully cleared up all lag on levels 201 and The END. 20 is much better, but can still get jittery at times. We hope to have 20 cleared of lag soon.

[b]Redid level 2.1[/b]

More props, better lighting, and a more defined exit are all features of the new level 2.1. It's still in the same spot though as the last update.

[b]Redid the subscriber/booster/Patreon wall[/b]

The subs wall has grown so much, that now it's too big and unorganized to understand. So, we added headings, and we separated the text into chunks,

[b]Reduced the density of level 10's wheat and fog[/b]

This level not only looks better but is less laggy in some spots! Now you can see the sun beating down on you while you play a game of checkers with the gluff (I wish that was a thing)

[b]The mac-11 is now an open bolt weapon[/b]

I'll just put it plain and simple, this one is embarrassing. Somehow, we hadn't recognized that it is an open bolt weapon this entire time. The Mac-11 was the first weapon in the game, released in 1.0. Not sure how this slipped by us for over a year.

[b]Changed the bullets inside of the 1911 magazine to look better[/b]

Paul and I were getting tired of literal cylinders, so now they're replaced with actual 45 ACP bullets in the magazine.

[b]New grenade sounds[/b]

The sounds for pulling the pin and the boom have been improved, as well as it now plays a blood sound effect for each entity it kills.

That's it for this week, we'll be back next week with some more craziness. Explosive craziness!
